_comment: Risk is policy, kept separate from the MCC taxonomy (spec section 5) so rules can change without touching mcc_catalog.json. Any code not listed here defaults to STANDARD. Tiers are GWEB's own risk language, not a claim that an MCC is universally high-risk.

6012.reason: Financial institution merchandise/services - Mastercard flags for specialized handling

6051.reason: Quasi-cash (currency exchange, money orders, crypto) - elevated fraud/AML exposure

6211.reason: Securities brokers/dealers - regulated financial product, issuer scrutiny

6300.reason: Insurance sales/underwriting - regulated product, licensing verification needed

7995.reason: Betting/gambling - unsupported by many acquirers without specific licensing

provider_overrides._comment: Example only: acquirers/processors can apply stricter policy to the same MCC than GWEB's base policy (spec section 5). acme_processor here does not support pawn shops at all, even though GWEB's base policy only requires enhanced review.

5933.reason: acme_processor does not underwrite pawn/salvage merchants
